# Laudica

> Laudica is a social proof engine for modern SaaS. It helps businesses collect, organize, and deploy customer testimonials to increase conversions.

## What Laudica Does

Laudica is a testimonial management platform that lets you:

- Collect testimonials via customizable forms, paste-to-import, or CSV upload
- Organize testimonials with tags, ratings, and approval workflows
- Build showcase walls using 9 display styles (cards grid, carousel, ticker tape, masonry, vertical marquee, spotlight stack, orbit, fade rotator, minimal list)
- Deploy contextual walls that show the right testimonials on the right page using tag-based filtering
- Embed walls on any website via HTML/JS snippet, iframe, or React component
- Track analytics on views and engagement

## Key Features

- 9 showcase display styles with live preview
- Smart contextual walls with tag-based filtering
- Embeddable on any platform (HTML, React, WordPress, Webflow)
- Domain-locked embeds for security
- GDPR-compliant analytics
- API access for custom integrations (Business plan)
- White-label embedding (Business plan)

## Pricing

- Free: $0/month — 15 testimonials, 3 walls, all display styles
- Pro: $29/month — Unlimited testimonials and walls, custom branding, analytics
- Business: $79/month — API access, white-label embeds, unlimited team seats
